### ✨ InstaPro for Instagram (v5.0.0)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Download Feed Media (HD)** — Save photos, videos, and carousels in highest quality
- **Download Reels & Stories** — One-tap download for any Reel or Story
- **Ghost Mode (Anonymous Stories)** — View stories without appearing in the seen list
- **Hide DM Read Receipts** — Read Direct Messages without marking them as Seen
- **Hide Typing Indicator** — Type in Direct Messages without showing Typing...
- **Block All Ads & Sponsored Posts** — Clean feed & stories with zero advertisements
- **Copy Comments, Bios & Captions** — Long-press any text to copy to clipboard
- **Full HD Profile Picture Zoom** — Long-press any avatar to view in full resolution

### ✨ Free Release
- **No Token Required**: Unlocked out of the box.
- **Telegram Developer**: **@m0hmm3d**
